_comment: Hand-written mappings by ITEM name (the display names in qud/data/spells.json), applied after SpellDB.effect_for's rules and the record's own 'kart' hint from tools/qud_items.py. Artifacts likewise. spells: keys replace fields of the effect dict. artifacts: the whole bonus set (keys from Artifacts.KEYS). 'notes' is ignored. Kinds: bolt beam blast melee burst aura patch summon shield heal buff empower blink hex. Extras: count (multi-shot), stun (s), shove (px/s, negative pulls), heal_frac (drain), only_stunned, tick/duration/radius/range (px, one game tile = 90 px), bonuses (empower). See docs/rulebook.md and docs/rules-pass-prompt.md.

High Explosive Grenade Mk III.notes: the big one: a 5d6 x 7000-force blast, the race's best area hit
